executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Evidence sufficient but continued tool selection exhausted all model calls; no budget-aware finalization
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Reserve answer generation within the existing hard model-call limit

findings.title: No finalization opportunity within hard model budget
findings.mechanism: All 8 model outputs request tools; the SDK refuses a subsequent model call and no answer exists
findings.root_cause: Hard budget exists without exposing remaining budget or reserving an answer phase
findings.recommended_fix: Reserve at least one answer-only call within the total budget, preserving cancellation and permission checks

findings.title: Known upstream search failure is recorded as success
findings.mechanism: The second search returned a structured 429 error but ToolMessage and RunAction both report success
findings.root_cause: Protocol success is used as business success without mapping the known provider error envelope
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve protocol errors and narrowly normalize known provider error envelopes

findings.title: Query-selected passages and local preview completeness are different scopes
findings.mechanism: All extract calls specify query; returned fragments include omission markers and repeated reads provide incomplete context
findings.root_cause: The result representation lacks explicit retrieval scope and encourages re-querying rather than answering the bounded question
findings.recommended_fix: Expose per-source content and distinguish passages, full source content, and local preview; prefer relevant authoritative documents

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Reserve answer-only phase under the original hard limit
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Directly addresses the empty final answer
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Improved delivery rate without unbounded calls

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Improve evidence scope and bounded research strategy
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Official integration evidence already existed before the last call
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Less redundant retrieval and clearer uncertainty

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Run a frozen-trace factorial evaluation before choosing a model change
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: One incident cannot separate model ability from tool and harness effects
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Evidence-based selection of prompts, tools, budgets and models

limits: 62-second model action has no provider-internal latency decomposition
